documents.pages_rationale: Land Use Bylaw 1P2007 is a 1053-page multi-district bylaw. Two disjoint deliverable spans are scoped: the suite/deemed-conforming block (s.347-360, pp.389-401, the prior gold) and the R-CG (Residential - Grade-Oriented Infill) District (s.525-546, pp.465-478; s.547 begins p.479). Scoping the corpus to these spans focuses extraction on the deliverable and makes the M5 scored-slot denominator reflect Calgary's low-density-infill scope instead of the whole bylaw.
documents.target_concept: Residential – Grade-Oriented Infill (R-CG) District dimensional envelope: building setbacks from front, side, and rear property lines; building height; parcel coverage; building depth; and street-facing facade width; including the secondary suite and backyard suite provisions
